name: avatar
useFor: Use for an organisation, a team member or a site's thumbnail beside its name (size sm is 24px in rows). Always give an AvatarFallback with one uppercase initial. AvatarBadge marks someone or something live with a Fern diamond; AvatarGroup lists who shares a project, with AvatarGroupCount for the rest.
